device_entry.name: Teledyne LeCroy MAUI数字示波器
tags: 瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: 这是一类配备 MAUI 用户界面的中高端数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析高速电信号波形。它通常支持多通道输入、触发控制、自动测量、统计分析、数学运算和参考波形管理，常用于电子电路、通信、嵌入式系统和通用实验室调试测试。
device_entry.description_en: This is a family of medium- to high-end digital oscilloscopes with the MAUI user interface, used to capture, display, and analyze high-speed electrical waveforms. They typically support multi-channel acquisition, trigger control, automatic measurements, statistical analysis, math functions, and reference waveform handling for electronics, communications, embedded systems, and general laboratory debugging and test work.
